why: None of the key's six problems covers new-hire scrap (P6 is about senior know-how and first articles). But the truth tables do contain a 'new hire' scrap cause: 4,005 scrap reports and 5,811 pieces over 2016-2025, present in every year (269-1,058 pieces a year) (t430, t432). The truth also backs the finding's labelling point: 4,277 of those 5,811 pieces were coded 'operator error' and none 'dimension out of tolerance', while most DOT scrap is true 'process' scrap (18,356 pieces) (t430). The finding's 353.8 excess pieces a year is the right effect, but smaller than the truth's roughly 581 a year.
